edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [purchase price to be agreed] (the “Purchase Price”) for the Shares by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing, without escrow, deduction, or setoff, except any withholding required by applicable law. Payment shall occur concurrently with delivery of duly executed instruments transferring the Shares to the Buyer.

2. CLOSING. The closing of the purchase and sale of the Shares (“Closing”) shall occur on a date agreed by the parties in writing, no later than thirty days after signing (the “Outside Date”), subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the party entitled to its benefit of the closing conditions expressly agreed in this Agreement. At Closing, payment of the Purchase Price and delivery of duly executed instruments transferring the Shares shall occur concurrently. Required approvals, closing conditions, and deliverables shall be specified in Schedule [to be agreed]. If Closing has not occurred by the Outside Date, either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice to the other, provided that the terminating party is not then in material breach of this Agreement and its breach has not caused the failure to close. Termination shall not release either party from liability for any prior breach. The Outside Date may be extended by written agreement of both parties.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents to the Buyer, as of signing and Closing, that the financial statements identified in Schedule [to be agreed] fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position of the issuer of the Shares as of the dates specified therein, in accordance with [agreed accounting standards], subject only to the exceptions fairly disclosed in that Schedule. For purposes of this Agreement, a matter is “fairly disclosed” only if disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedules in sufficient detail to enable a reasonable buyer to identify its nature and scope.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses actually incurred arising from liabilities of the issuer of the Shares existing at Closing or attributable to periods before Closing, to the extent not fairly disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedules. Recovery shall be subject to a basket of USD [to be agreed], operating as [deductible or tipping basket—to be agreed], and an aggregate cap of USD [to be agreed]. Section 3 and the right to assert claims under this Section shall survive Closing for twelve months. A claim notified in writing within that period, identifying its factual basis and reasonably estimated amount to the extent then known, shall survive until finally resolved. The Buyer shall give reasonably prompt written notice of claims; delay shall relieve the Seller of liability only to the extent materially prejudiced, provided that notice must be given within the survival period. The Seller may assume the defense of a third-party claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to the Buyer upon acknowledging its indemnity obligation, but may not control a claim involving criminal allegations, material nonmonetary relief, or a material conflict of interest. The Buyer may participate through separate counsel at its own expense, except where a material conflict requires separate representation. Neither party may settle a claim in a manner imposing liability, an admission, or any nonmonetary obligation on the other without that party’s prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld. The parties shall reasonably cooperate in the defense of claims. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate losses, and recoverable losses shall include reasonable mitigation costs. There shall be no double recovery for the same loss, and recovery shall be reduced by insurance or third-party proceeds actually received for that loss, net of reasonable collection costs. The Seller shall respond to a direct claim within thirty days after receipt; failure to respond shall not constitute acceptance, and unresolved claims remain subject to the agreed dispute-resolution provisions.

Governing law, dispute resolution, notices, and other customary general provisions must also be completed before execution.

Price remains reserved; we will seek the requested particulars and schedules from our client, and require closing conditions to be objective and expressly enumerated, with no financing contingency or discretionary Buyer-satisfaction condition.
